_purpose: External tool connections for Claude Code, via the Model Context Protocol. Committed so the whole team shares the same external surface. Secrets come from env vars - never hardcode tokens here.
_when_you_want_a_file_like_this: Whenever you want Claude Code sessions to have access to external systems (GitHub, your DB, Slack) without writing custom tool integrations.
_why_it_matters: MCP gives Claude an extensible, typed tool surface (GitHub, Postgres, Slack, your DB, ...) without bespoke integration code.
Committing the config means every teammate's session sees the same tools - one less per-developer setup step.
Secrets via env keeps the file safe to commit.
_what_goes_in_it: One entry per server under mcpServers.<name>.
Each entry declares the command and args used to launch the server (typically `npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-<name>`).
Sensitive values reference env vars with ${VAR}; the vars themselves live in .env / .env.example.
